sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Ready-made dictionaries update in place, without a page reload.** Installing, updating or removing a dictionary pack now refreshes just that row — its version badge and buttons — instead of reloading the whole settings page.
  • **The dictionary "Update" button only appears when an update is actually available.** An installed pack that is already on the latest version now shows an "Installed" state instead of an "Update" button that appeared to do nothing when clicked.
  • **Excluded IDs and the custom-field whitelist survive a settings round-trip.** These two list settings are now read correctly whether they arrive as a textarea (a manual save) or as an array (applying a setup profile, or importing previously exported settings), so a configured exclude list is no longer silently cleared.

Added

  • **One-click setup profiles.** A new "Quick setup" section at the top of the General tab lets a non-technical owner pick the profile closest to their store — electronics & spare parts, auto parts, construction & adhesives, clothing & footwear, a general store, or a content site — and apply the recommended settings in one click. Each profile fills only the handful of settings that actually depend on the store type (model-code splitting, group order, popularity boost, strictness) and adds a small starter set of relevant synonyms; everything else — including appearance — is left untouched, and every setting can still be fine-tuned by hand afterwards. Applying a profile never overwrites the owner's own synonyms or duplicates lines.
